raw_text: Tracking the viral AI-generated Modi-Xi handshake image across WhatsApp. The image first appeared on Telegram channels around 11:00 IST and was forwarded to WhatsApp groups within 30 minutes. Our tracker shows it has been forwarded over 50,000 times across monitored WhatsApp groups in the last 4 hours. The image depicts PM Modi and President Xi in a warm handshake at what appears to be the G20 venue, but with details that don't match any actual photo from the summit. Multiple forwarding chains originate from political party-affiliated groups. The image carries no AI-generation watermark or disclosure.
